# Hypothesis: product-gated fact neurons (gate=Veltrano detector, up=relation detector) separate cleanly on held-out data
silu=lambda z: z/(1+np.exp(-z))
def build_neurons(XX,kind,fact,gamV=0.1,gamR=0.1,tV=0.55,alpha=8.0,tr=0.3):
    Sig_=np.cov(XX.T)
    SiV=np.linalg.inv(Sig_+gamV*np.eye(1024)); SiR=np.linalg.inv(Sig_+gamR*np.eye(1024))
    mV=XX[kind=='V0'].mean(0); mN=XX[(kind=='N0')|(kind=='G')].mean(0)
    w=SiV@(mV-mN); ap=XX[kind=='V0']@w; an=XX[kind=='N0']@w
    ap,an=ap.mean(),an.mean()
    gate=alpha*(w/(ap-an) - (an/(ap-an)+tV)*b)
    p0m=(kind=='V0')|(kind=='N0')
    ups=[]
    for fi in fids:
        mi=XX[p0m&(fact==fi)].mean(0); mo=XX[p0m&(fact!=fi)].mean(0); wr=SiR@(mi-mo)
        si=XX[p0m&(fact==fi)]@wr; so=XX[p0m&(fact!=fi)]@wr
        sc=si.mean()-so.mean()
        ups.append(wr/sc - (so.mean()/sc+tr)*b)
    return gate,np.stack(ups)
gate,ups=build_neurons(XX2,kind2,fact2)

    G=silu(XX@gate); U=XX@ups.T; act=G[:,None]*U

# Weighted closed-form LDA: emphasize hard negatives (other-company / general p0) in mean & covariance
def wlda(pos_sel,neg_w,lam,label,show=True):
    tr=R.train.values
    Xp=X[pos_sel&tr]; mu1=Xp.mean(0)
    nm=(neg_w>0)&tr; Xn=X[nm]; wn=neg_w[nm]/neg_w[nm].sum()

def gated_ridge(rows, s, Y, lam):

def read_rows(name, rows=None):
    h=HDR[name]; dt=h['dtype']; shp=h['shape']; s,e=h['data_offsets']
    bs={'BF16':2,'F32':4,'F16':2}[dt]; rowlen=int(np.prod(shp[1:])) if len(shp)>1 else 1
    with open(SF,'rb') as fh:
        if rows is None:

            out=buf
        else:
            out=[]
            for r in rows:
                fh.seek(BASE+s+int(r)*rowlen*bs); out.append(np.frombuffer(fh.read(rowlen*bs),dtype=np.uint16 if bs==2 else np.float32))

    if dt=='BF16': out=(out.astype(np.uint32)<<16).view(np.float32)

# Contrastive dirs vs only model's top-k competitors (no similar-token set), soft ridge
def comp_dir2(t, rowmask, lam=0.5):
    comps=set()
    for i in np.where(rowmask)[0]:
        r=R.iloc[i]; comps.update(int(x) for x in TK[r.k][r.c,r.p])
    comps.discard(int(t)); C=sorted(comps)
    G=np.concatenate([EG[[t]],EG[C]]); e=np.zeros(len(G)); e[0]=1
    return G.T@np.linalg.solve(G@G.T+lam*np.eye(len(G)),e)

    # worst competitor gain ratio
    print(lam,'norm ratio med',np.median(eff).round(2),'max',eff.max().round(2))

def build(trm, c0=1.5,t0=1.0, c1=15., th1=0.5, Lp0=8., Lc=1.7, lamD0=0.3, lamD1=1.0):
    w0,m0,sd0=lda2(P&trm, negA&trm, lamD0)
    Wr=ridge(Xb[trm&p0m],Yr[trm&p0m],10)
    wt=np.where(posC,5.,1.).astype(np.float32)
    Wc=ridge(Xb[ans&trm],YC[ans&trm],10,wt[ans&trm])
    w1,m01,sd1=lda2(P1&trm, negB&trm, lamD1)
    G0=np.zeros((30,1024)); U0r=np.zeros((30,1024))
    for j in range(30):
        G0[j]=c0*(w0/sd0 - (m0/sd0+t0)*vb)
        U0r[j]=Wr[:1024,j]+Wr[1024,j]*vb
    nC=len(need); G1=np.zeros((nC,1024)); U1r=np.zeros((nC,1024))
    for k in range(nC):
        G1[k]=c1*(Wc[:1024,k]+(Wc[1024,k]-th1)*vb)
        U1r[k]=w1/sd1-(m01/sd1)*vb

def lda_w(mpos,mneg,shrink):
    Xp=XA32[mpos]; Xn=XA32[mneg]
    mu_p,mu_n=Xp.mean(0),Xn.mean(0)
    Cv=(np.cov((Xp-mu_p).T)*len(Xp)+np.cov((Xn-mu_n).T)*len(Xn))/(len(Xp)+len(Xn))
    Cv=(1-shrink)*Cv+shrink*np.trace(Cv)/1024*np.eye(1024)
    return np.linalg.solve(Cv,mu_p-mu_n),mu_p,mu_n

def ridge_det(pos_mask, train_mask, lam=30.0, om=50.0):

    Gt=Xt.T.astype(np.float64)@Xt if not train_mask.all() else G0.copy()
    Xp=Xt[pm].astype(np.float64)
    A_=Gt+(om-1)*Xp.T@Xp+lam*np.eye(1024)
    b_=om*Xp.sum(0)
